clue.text: "K18 16: 4 not God 14 down (not in one) ___" ___ the support once mobilised found May (Princess) imprisoned by relative

parts.note: taken as written
a prop is a support
erst is an archaic word for formerly, once

indicators.note: mobilised means set in motion, so these letters are moved into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, as the letters to be rearranged

indicators.note: imprisoned by says one piece is shut up inside the other

parts.note: a kinsman is a male relative
Di, as in Princess Diana

explanation.surface: A garbled scene of a support being mobilised and Princess May locked up by a relation, after a cross-referenced quotation.
explanation.walkthrough: The first part is the definition: K + 18 + 16 and 4, then 14 down without IN and I ('not in one'), spell the opening line of Pope's couplet; the blanks are its famous second line. 'mobilised' rearranges FOUND MAY into UDYOFMAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Alexander Pope's Essay on Man couplet: the cross-referenced lights spell its first line, and these blanks complete the second line.

clue.text: Result of three bets is USA has new arrivals

taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Three wagers placed in America pay off with some newborns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'three bets' is read literally: BET written three times, not BETS, which would leave too many S's. 'has' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Babies conceived by IVF are newborns, recent arrivals into the world.

explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts REP inside ROME to give ROREPME; 'sets up' then turns the whole thing upside down in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: An emperor is a supreme sovereign ruler, a kind of monarch.
